name: Friday the 13th Traffic
description: Traffic volume on Friday the 6th vs. Friday the 13th on the same stretch of the M25 motorway. Is there less traffic on the 13th? IMS Ch. 21.
studyDescription: Scanlon and colleagues obtained traffic flows from the British Department of Transport for two stretches of the M25 motorway — between junctions 7 and 8, and between junctions 9 and 10 — on five pairs of consecutive Fridays between 1990 and 1992. Each pair is the same stretch of road counted on Friday the 6th and again on Friday the 13th, giving n = 10 paired observations. This is an observational study.

variableDescriptions.sixth: Vehicles counted on that stretch of the M25 on Friday the 6th.
variableDescriptions.thirteenth: Vehicles counted on the same stretch on the following Friday the 13th.

sourceDetail: OpenIntro IMS, Chapter 21; openintro::friday, the rows with type = "traffic". Scanlon, T.J., Luben, R.N., Scanlon, F.L. & Singleton, N. (1993), 'Is Friday the 13th Bad For Your Health?', BMJ 307:1584-1586.

context.nullClaim: there is no difference in traffic between Friday the 6th and Friday the 13th

inferenceContexts.parameter: the population mean difference in traffic volume (6th − 13th)
inferenceContexts.claim: traffic volume is lower on Friday the 13th compared to the preceding Friday
